title: POV: You Forgot Your Lunch on Night Shift (ADHD) 😂
desc:
Made the best lunch of my life. Put it in the fridge so it stays cold. Then I left it there. 😂

Night shift, 2 AM break, crackers and car gum for dinner.

Tip: put your car keys in the fridge right on top of your lunch. You can't leave without them.

What's the best lunch YOU ever left at home? 👇

If this is you, you're not alone.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #nightshift #relatable #funny #shorts
tags: what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's a normal person on night shift. Pack lunch. Grab lunch. Eat lunch at break.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now me. Ten o'clock. I make the best lunch of my whole life. Leftover lasagna. Two cookies.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I put it in the fridge so it stays cold. Smart. Responsible. Grown.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Keys. Badge. Phone. Water bottle. I check everything. Twice.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Something feels missing. I pat my pockets. Nope. Everything's here.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Eleven. Clock in. I'm locked in. Nobody can stop me tonight.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: One thirty. My stomach starts talking. I tell it, relax. Lasagna's coming.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I open my bag. Keys. Badge. Phone. Water. No lasagna.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I text my wife. Is my lunch in the fridge? She sends a picture. It's in there. Living its best life.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: So dinner is vending machine crackers and a pack of gum I found in the car. I still said grace. Lord, thank You. And please let somebody bring donuts.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Seven thirty in the morning. I get home. Open the fridge. There it is. Still perfect.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: So I eat lasagna for breakfast. Honestly? Best part of the shift.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's the trick. If it's not in your hand, it's not in your head. Put your car keys in the fridge, right on top of your lunch. You can't leave without them.
If this is you, you're not alone. What's the best lunch you ever left at home? Tell me in the comments.
beats.cap: If this is you, you're not alone.
